a.lede: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.
a.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question

b.lede: Hugging Face's CEO pledged to keep fighting for open source AI after Huang's exit, raising questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.
b.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
